business description: Project Ember is a residential HVAC and plumbing service, repair and installation company in Ontario.
competitive advantage: A maintenance membership program brings customers back every season; licensed technicians do the work in-house.
reason for sale: The Owner is retiring.
transition plan: A 6-month transition with the Owner, who stays through the heating season to help the buyer.
seller financing: The Owner will carry part of the purchase price over a few years.
